title: Plantations: sugar and slavery
goal: Read about the sugar plantations and the transatlantic slave trade, and use the passive with ser to say what was done to Africans.

items: Use the passive with *ser* to say what was done to Africans in the plantation economy.
Say where sugar was mainly grown.
Compare how many Africans left Africa and how many arrived in America, according to SlaveVoyages.
Say what the text says about Brazil and about the end of slavery.
Use the key words of the plantation economy: sugar, plantation, sugar mill, slavery and owner.
